fields.title: 6. Competition and Structure Memo — SpaceX's Three Terrestrial Network Paths (Based on Reports, Not a Verdict)
fields.md:
| Path | Status (2026-11-02) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| MVNO capacity lease from the three carriers | Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile **declined** (reported) — TD Cowen: "unlikely to sign an MVNO deal that would shake up the industry" (opinion) | [Yahoo Finance 11/02](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/spacex-weighs-boost-mobile-deal-in-push-for-starlink-phone-service-report-160901851.html) |
| MVNO acquisition (Boost) | Preliminary talks (reported) — Boost leases AT&T and T-Mobile networks; consent may be needed for transfer | [TechCrunch 11/02](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/spacex-reportedly-wants-to-buy-boost-mobile-to-compete-with-att-t-mobile-and-verizon/) |
| Self-build (65MHz spectrum + Grain 800MHz + direct acquisition of terrestrial licenses under the FCC NPRM) | Verizon CEO "4–6 years", Musk "half of that" (statements) · TD Cowen "$80 billion or more" (opinion) | [Yahoo Finance 11/02](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/spacex-weighs-boost-mobile-deal-in-push-for-starlink-phone-service-report-160901851.html) · `reports/2026-11.md` 1-2 |

How to read: across all three paths, **the only item confirmed by filings is the spectrum purchase**. The verdict input for A-2028-1 (separate disclosure of D2C revenue) arises only if it is captured in the revenue line, whichever path is taken (source: table above · `state.milestones[A-2028-1]`).
